# Zhuhai Xiaodu Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd.

> Zhuhai-based industrial automation and intelligent manufacturing project delivery for customers in China and overseas.

## What the company does

- Industrial robotics and automation system integration.
- Machine vision, inspection and production data platforms.
- Automated sampling and laboratory automation.
- Custom equipment, production line integration and project engineering.
